caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sewing caddy placed on a round, brown base. At the center top is a large, red pincushion with a pink ribbon tied around it, forming a bow at the front. Hanging from the edge of the pincushion is a small red heart-shaped object suspended by a looped string. Beside and below the pincushion, attached to the structure, are two small wicker baskets, one on the left and one on the right. Four spools of thread in various colors—black, white, and pink—are positioned upright on metal holders fixed into the round base. The background is plain and light beige. The name "EUGENE W. McGILL" is written near the bottom center of the image.
title: Sewing Stand
